title: Base-station query and RTK base telemetry -- first live results
probe_conclusion: command_sent true; 101 samples at 150 ms over 15 s; ZERO query-only fields ever observed and no clobber detected, so the report-channel race is ruled out and this is a real negative for THIS read path.
probe_defect_found: The probe reads mower.report_data.basestation_info, but this installation has a SEPARATE RTK device (rtkbna235279309) whose base.to_app frames are reduced by RTKStateReducer onto RTKBaseStationDevice. The probe may simply be reading the wrong object.
correction_chain: internet NTRIP/MQTT source -> base station (WiFi) -> LoRa E22 datalink -> mower

base_self_position_history_utc.note: 22:19:14 UTC = 18:19:14 EDT = the operator power cycle, NOT the Float onset (15:40 EDT). Reverted after ~47 min.

float_onset_check: No change recorded in base position_mode, satellites, latitude or longitude across the 15:40 EDT Float onset.
resolution_caveat: RTK device telemetry is recorded only ~9 times in 12.5 h (roughly hourly). The negative at Float onset is therefore weakly resolved -- a transient well under an hour would not appear.
